description: Look up Meta's official WhatsApp Business (Cloud) API per-message rates from the site's dated rate card, the same figures the pricing calculator uses, so prefer this over recalling or guessing prices. Give a market to get one row, or omit it for every market in the chosen currency. Returns the current list price per template category (marketing, utility, authentication, and authentication-international where a market has one), the currency, the effective and last-verified dates, the source link and the CC BY licence. Optionally include the published volume-tier thresholds and rates for a single market. This is Meta's platform fee only: a BSP/provider adds its own fee on top, so treat it as a floor. Runs locally.

currency.description: One of the 16 currencies Meta publishes a card in (USD, EUR, GBP, INR, IDR, BRL, MXN, ARS, COP, AED, SAR, AUD, MYR, PEN, CLP, SGD). Rates are stored per currency exactly as Meta prints them, never converted. Optional, default USD.

include_tiers.description: When a single market is given, also return that market's published volume-tier thresholds and per-band rates for utility and authentication. Ignored when no market is given. Optional, default false.

market.description: Recipient market as a 2-letter code (e.g. "US"/"NA", "IN", "BR", "GB", "DE") or a "Rest of" region id. Omit to return the whole rate card for the chosen currency.

name: get_whatsapp_rates
